title: Selectors for the four constructible coefficient stages
statement: Fix a finite-field coefficient datum, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an integer $n\geq1$, and the recorded six-functor operation datum $S$ [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Define the coefficient-stage index to have the four values finite, integral, rational and common (algebraically closed coefficients). For a finite-type geometric scheme $X$ in $S$, select at these values respectively its recorded bounded constructible finite-quotient, derived-complete integral, rationalized and common-finite-stage categories, with their inherited category structures. Select the recorded finite-Tor domain at finite and integral stages and the whole constructible category at rational and common stages. Select the existing pullback, direct image, compact support, exceptional inverse image, permitted internal-Hom pair domain and internal Hom at the chosen stage. Select the recorded tensor with unrestricted constructible first input and finite-Tor second input; at finite coefficients use the actual partial tensor of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates], and at the other stages restrict the recorded tensor through the selected domain inclusion. These are selectors and full-subcategory restrictions of existing data; no existence of restricted adjunctions or additional preservation property is asserted.
